parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex rhythm at about 70 bpm with left axis deviation (rS in II, III and aVF, qR in I and aVL, consistent with left anterior fascicular block), very deep S waves in V1–V3 with poor R-wave progression, and T-wave inversions in V1–V5. There is no significant ST elevation, and the pattern fits none of the listed categories cleanly.
